title: Cursor Cuts Prices, Adds Enterprise Controls
excerpt: The AI coding assistance market is undergoing a major shift as Cursor announces significant price cuts and new enterprise spending controls. This signals a maturation in the industry moving from unlimited consumption to ROI-focused governance and tighter budget management.
post_draft:
Is your AI tool budget spiraling out of control?

Cursor just sent a signal to the entire coding assistance market: unlimited consumption is over.

They've cut prices significantly and launched enterprise spending controls—a move that tells us something bigger is happening. The industry is shifting from "buy as much AI as you want" to "prove your ROI and stick to your budget."

For engineering leaders and security teams, this matters. It means vendors are finally taking governance seriously. It means you'll have actual levers to control costs instead of surprise bills at the end of the month.

We're entering the era of mature AI tool economics. Tokenomics aren't just for crypto anymore—they're reshaping how companies think about AI adoption.

Read the full breakdown to understand what Cursor's move means for your team and the market.
